Because the shale audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 7 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 71 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
